findings.claim: The recursive-output safety check can be bypassed through a symlink beneath the system temporary directory.
findings.evidence: The check uses lexical path resolution without real-path or ownership validation before recursive cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve real paths, reject symlinks, require a generator-created ownership marker, and revalidate before cleanup.

findings.claim: The verification receipt is not bound to the tested revision.
findings.evidence: The source section records the base SHA and mutable branch name, not an exact verified implementation commit.
findings.suggested_fix: Record the exact verified implementation HEAD SHA used for reported gates.

findings.claim: The receipt does not confirm completion of the four prerequisite documentation changes.
findings.evidence: The verification block does not name v3-docs-api-reference, v3-docs-concepts-packages, v3-docs-examples-integrations, or v3-docs-operations-migration.
findings.suggested_fix: Add fail-closed prerequisite verification naming all four changes and their evidence.
